decisions.reason: It had its own page for two years and aligns with the announced broadening, so the sunk costs and public commitment make management likely to continue it.

Reissued jazz vinyl is central to the label's expertise, and the sunk costs in licensing and pressing, plus temporary disruptions, favor keeping it.
